Package com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.tags

Class PlaceObject4Tag

java.lang.Object
com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.tags.Tag
com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.tags.base.PlaceObjectTypeTag
com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.tags.PlaceObject4Tag
All Implemented Interfaces:
ASMSourceContainer, CharacterIdTag, DepthTag, Exportable, NeedsCharacters, TreeItem, HasCharacterId, Serializable
public class PlaceObject4Tag extends PlaceObjectTypeTag implements ASMSourceContainer
PlaceObject4 tag - adds character to the display list. Extends the functionality of the PlaceObject3Tag - adds AMF3 data.
Author:
JPEXS
